title: 正确实现：反向遍历
behavior_notes: 正确实现：以末元素 `arr[n-1]` 为初值，从 $n$-2 反向遍历到 0，覆盖完整、下标合法（$n>=1$ 时 $n$-1 与 $n$-2 均在范围内或循环不执行）。

diagnosis.summary: 提交正确：以 `arr[n-1]` 为初值、从 $n$-2 递减遍历到 0，初始化、覆盖完整性与比较方向都符合要求。问卷用于确认学生对遍历范围、终止条件与覆盖完整性的理解（尤其是反向遍历与 $n$=1 的边界）。
diagnosis.summary_en: Correct reverse traversal: max starts at `arr[n - 1]` and every earlier index is examined. The questionnaire confirms coverage reasoning and edge cases.

questions.question: 用 `arr[n - 1]` 作为 $max$ 的初始值，为什么是安全的？
choices: 它是数组中确实存在的合法候选；在 $n >= 1$ 的约定下该下标总是可访问
因为最后一个元素一定就是最大值
因为任何负数都可以做初值
并不安全：`arr[n-1]` 是越界访问
questions.question_en: Why is it safe to use `arr[n - 1]` as the initial value of max here?
choices_en: It is a valid candidate that really exists in the array; under the guarantee $n >= 1$ that index is always accessible
Because the last element is always the maximum
Because any negative number works as an initial value
It is not safe: `arr[n-1]` is an out-of-bounds access

questions.question: 循环 `for (int i = n - 2; i >= 0; i--)` 一共检查了哪些元素？
choices: 从 `arr[n-2]` 回到 `arr[0]` 的全部元素；`arr[n-1]` 已用作初值
只检查了数组的前一半
检查了包括 `arr[n-1]` 在内的全部元素
questions.question_en: Which elements does the loop `for (int i = n - 2; i >= 0; i--)` examine?
choices_en: All elements from `arr[n-2]` back to `arr[0]`; `arr[n-1]` already served as the initial value
Only the first half of the array

questions.question: 当 $n$ = 1 时，这个函数的行为是什么？
choices: 初值取 `arr[0]`，循环条件 $n$-2 = -1 不满足，直接返回 `arr[0]`
questions.question_en: When n = 1, what does this function do?
choices_en: The initial value is `arr[0]`; the loop condition $n$-2 = -1 fails immediately, so `arr[0]` is returned

questions.question: 反向遍历与正向遍历在正确性上为什么等价？请从“覆盖”的角度用一两句话说明。
questions.expected_answer: 两者都先取一个数组元素做初值，再让其余每个元素恰好参与一次比较；只要覆盖完整且更新方向正确，遍历顺序不影响最终的最大值。

variants: 两者都先取一个数组元素做初值，再让其余每个元素恰好参与一次比较；只要覆盖完整且更新方向正确，遍历顺序不影响最终的最大值。
都是从初值出发覆盖其余全部元素，顺序不影响结果，覆盖完整才是关键。
等价的原因是覆盖：每个元素都被比较到，最大值与检查顺序无关。
samples.note: 从覆盖角度正确解释了等价性
samples.note_en: Correctly explained the equivalence from a coverage perspective

samples.note: 结论正确，但没有从覆盖角度解释
samples.note_en: Correct conclusion, but did not explain it from a coverage perspective

variants: 反向会先找到小元素，所以结果可能不同。
反向遍历会漏掉一半元素，只有正向才正确。

questions.question_en: Why is reverse traversal equivalent to forward traversal in correctness? Explain from the coverage perspective in a sentence or two.

questions.question: 假设修改：把第 2 行改成 int $max$ = `arr[0]`;（循环仍从 $i$ = $n$ - 2 开始反向遍历）。对输入 `[1, 2, 9]`（$n$ = 3），程序返回什么？（点击本题可在左侧预览修改后的代码）
questions.question_en: Hypothetical change: line 2 becomes int max = `arr[0]`; while the loop still walks in reverse from i = n - 2. For the input `[1, 2, 9]` (n = 3), what does the program return? (Click this question to preview the modified code on the left)
choices: 2，`arr[n-1]` = 9 从未被比较，最大值丢失
choices_en: 2 — `arr[n-1]` = 9 is never compared, so the maximum is lost
It crashes with an out-of-bounds access

answers.q4: 都是从初值出发覆盖其余全部元素，顺序不影响结果，覆盖完整才是关键。
等价的原因是覆盖：每个元素都被比较到，最大值与检查顺序无关。
反向遍历会漏掉一半元素，只有正向才正确。

behavior_notes_en: Correct: initializes from `arr[n - 1]` and traverses in reverse; the questionnaire probes coverage and the n = 1 case.
